what: Stale manager id in the desk-wake create_session recipe: .claude/skills/trading-desk/SKILL.md line 124 (§ 6b) hard-codes tags ["manager:session_01HAysMLfF9dYpi92YMqYxEq", ...], a retired manager. A manager copying the recipe verbatim tags every desk wake with the wrong manager, so lane_reconcile / manager-tag lookups attribute desk wakes to a dead session. Fix (Tier 1, one line): replace the literal with the placeholder manager:<current Manager Session id> as the other routine prompts do, and grep the other skills for any hard-coded manager:session_ literal (precedent class: ROUTINE-PROMPTS-ON-ROTATION). Manager 30b worked around it by tagging with its own id.
